title: The Art of Balancing Passion and Profession
excerpt: Have you ever wondered how to stay true to your passions while thriving in your profession? For me, it's been a journey of trial, error, and most importantly, growth.

title: You're meant to be lived!
excerpt: If you feel things deeply, if the world has weathered you, if you are going through something that is uncomfortable or painful, or hard, you often must decide between allowing yourself to dive into those emotions or allowing yourself to numb them.
